title: Agnus Dei (Palestrina, Missa Veni sponsa Christi)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Veni sponsa Christi, Agnus Dei, 1599. 5 voices (Cantus, Altus, Quinta Pars, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
